svg.title: Entity-Relationship Diagram: Governance, Appeals, Notifications, and Audits
svg.text: Entity-Relationship Diagram (Part 3): Governance, Appeals & Security Audits
Strict separation of report triage vs explicit account sanctions, reconciled with migrations 0011-0013 (main@ecc22d2)
0013: active-only uniq; no SQL FK on target_id
Immutable sanction record + private evidence keys
Resolving a report never triggers sanctions. Account DISABLE revokes all refresh session families & protects in-flight orders. Appeals require an independent administrator.
